FN-2JX4GSS-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 323
Committee: Transportation, Utilities and Sponsor: Representative Donna Givens
Infrastructure
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 02/24/2025
House Bill 323 as introduced could decrease receipts to the Public Road and Bridge Fund by an
undetermined amount dependent on the amount of oversize/overweight permit fees for electric
utility commodities and equipment that would be exempt from these fees under the provisions
of this bill but that otherwise would be collected under current law.

House Bill 323 as passed the House of Representatives could decrease receipts to the Public
Road and Bridge Fund by an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of
oversize/overweight permit fees for electric utility commodities and equipment that would be
exempt from these fees under the provisions of this bill but that otherwise would be collected
under current law.

FN-2JX4GSS-3
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 323
Committee: Transportation and Energy Sponsor: Representative Donna Givens
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/15/2025
House Bill 323 as reported by the Committee on Transportation and Energy could decrease
receipts to the Public Road and Bridge Fund by an undetermined amount dependent on the
amount of oversize/overweight permit fees for electric utility commodities and equipment and
broadband or communications commodities and equipment that would be exempt from these
fees under the provisions of this bill but that otherwise would be collected under current law.
